name: Sweet Potato Soup
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Place the peeled potatoes, ginger, stock, and water in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then simmer until the potatoes are softened and tender (approximately 30 minutes).
Transfer the contents of the pot to a blender along with the lime juice, and process until smooth. You may need to work in batches. Alternatively, you can use an immersion blender.
Return the soup to the pot, stir in the milk, and allow to cook for few minutes until heated through.

culture.text: Soup is a primarily liquid food, generally served warm or hot – though it is sometimes served chilled – made by cooking or otherwise combining meat or vegetables with stock, milk, or water. According to The Oxford Companion to Food, soup is the main generic term for liquid savoury dishes; others include broth, bisque, consommé, potage and many more.
